basic_info.description: Nestled in one of San Francisco's most coveted neighborhoods, Parnassus Heights, this remarkable home rich with history has been beautifully reimagined for modern living. Originally built in 1924 by Robert Haight, the property retains its storied charm while embracing a fresh, contemporary design that enhances both form and function. The home features 2 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms on 2 levels, plus a carriage house at the street level which is currently used as a home office and gym. Design selections include custom lighting, lime wash paint, light colors to balance the abundance of natural light, and perfectly scaled furniture (some pieces could be available for sale separately). A masterful renovation by the designer-owner has opened up the interiors, allowing natural light to flood the space and creating impeccable indoor-outdoor flow. Throughout the residence, soaring ceilings, restored moldings, and carefully curated materials create a sense of balance between old and new. The primary suite offers a serene retreat, with a spa-like bath and expansive city views. Outside, the meticulously landscaped front and rear gardens provide a private oasis in the midst of the bustling city below. Published in Architectural Digest among others.
